title: OFAC Sanctions Compliance for Maritime Industry
abstract: Guidance for maritime shipping companies on compliance with U.S. sanctions programs, including vessel registration requirements and beneficial ownership disclosure.

notes.content: Key section on beneficial ownership (pp. 12-18) - shell company structures commonly used to obscure ownership

Private Equity Rollups in Healthcare: Market Consolidation and Patient Outcomes
abstract: We examine the effects of private equity-led consolidation in outpatient healthcare markets across Asia-Pacific. Using data from 2020-2024, we find that PE rollups are associated with price increases of 18-24% and mixed effects on care quality.

notes.content: Methodology on pp. 8-12 could be useful for analyzing Meridian's acquisition pattern. Note the 18-month integration timeline they identify.

title: LinkedIn Post: Richard Tan on Maritime Compliance Challenges

notes.content: Posted May 2025, shortly before leaving Pacific Star. Cryptic reference to 'institutional pressures to look the other way' - worth asking about in interview.

title: OFAC Maritime Sanctions Enforcement: Framework and Precedents 2020-2025
abstract: This article examines OFAC's enforcement framework for maritime sanctions violations from 2020-2025, analyzing precedent cases and compliance standards for vessel ownership documentation.

notes.note_text: Key framework paper - found during Jan 12 Zotero search. Provides comprehensive OFAC enforcement precedent analysis. Potential second-source for regulatory background section, but need to verify with on-record expert interview to meet two-source standard.

title: Vessel Ownership Sanctions Compliance: A Practical Guide for Maritime Insurers
abstract: Practical guidance for maritime insurers on vessel ownership documentation requirements under OFAC sanctions regimes, with case study analysis of enforcement actions.
